info.title: 4evergent HTTP API
info.description: Machine-readable description of the API served by apps/api/src/index.ts. Maintained by hand; scripts/check-openapi.mjs fails CI if the served route set and this document diverge. Human-readable reference: docs/api.md. Record schemas are intentionally loose (see packages/shared/src/types.ts).

x-excluded-routes.reason: Browser session routes handled in apps/api/src/auth.ts before the API auth gate. They use cookie sessions (four_eg_session) and redirects, not the Bearer integration surface, and are documented in prose in docs/api.md.

get.summary: List activity across all of the caller's agents
Get effective policy (DEFAULT_RULES with version 0 if none)

400.description: Invalid JSON, non-object body, or invalid policy ({error, details})

post.summary: Retry a failed or dead_letter execution (requires queue)
Cancel a queued or executing execution (requires queue)

404.description: Not found or not owned (approval-response shaped, status rejected)
Not found or not owned (approval-response shaped, status rejected)

bearerAuth.description: API key from API_KEYS. In development mode no header is needed.

NotFound.description: Not found or not owned by the caller

Conflict.description: State conflict, e.g. idempotency mismatch, paused agent, invalid transition
